# iamwilhelm.com

> Michael Wilhelm writes and builds scrollies: essays, poems, and stories read in the original languages and set as interactive web pages. Commissions from $2,500.

## Start here
- [What is a scrolly?](https://iamwilhelm.com/what-is-a-scrolly): definition, parts, cost, examples
- [Commissions](https://iamwilhelm.com/services): what I build, process, price, FAQ
- [Method](https://iamwilhelm.com/method): epistemic tagging, what is read in the original, what is machine-assisted
